entities.name: Rigida
entities.description: Ancient humanoid ice beings who rose to power at the start of the Ice Age and ruled the Glacial Kingdom over most of Almaaz.

entities.name: Glacial Kingdom
entities.description: Rigida civilization ruling most of Almaaz during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Drufalden
entities.description: Last remaining Rigida, who killed the other two sisters and reigned from an ice palace.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era begun at 450 AR in which the Rigida rose.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event after which the Rigida lost Almaaz.

events.summary: Drufalden kills the other two Rigida sisters and becomes the sole remaining Rigida.
events.quote: After killing the two others, Drufalden was the sole remaining

events.summary: In 3050 AR Ogwater Rifkin breaks Drufalden's hold and the ice of her queendom melts.
events.quote: her hold was broken by the songmage Ogwater Rifkin

events.summary: With the Flooding of Terisiare the Rigida lose their grip on Almaaz.
events.quote: the Rigida lost their grip on Almaaz
